translations.web: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
translations.bsb: How do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
translations.kjv: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?
translations.asv: For how knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? Or how knowest thou, O husband, whether thou shalt save thy wife?
